descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S15 「两台设备改同一份查房前记录：谁的话都不丢」 Both devices edit the same pre-round note: nobody's words are lost

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 A pre-round note dictated and saved on the computer appears on the phone in real time, with no refresh, and can be continued on the phone without re-entering anything.（UAT TC-25 step 3；UAT TC-25；TFA-94513 AC 11；TFA-94704 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • T2 Edits made on one device (not only add, generate and delete) show on the other in real time, with no refresh.（TFA-94704 AC 5；TFA-94513 AC 11） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U6 Steps 2-5 (add, pre-round save, generate, delete) work the same in Nursing Home as in Hospital.（UAT TC-25 step 6；UAT TC-25；UAT 3.3） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Phone has {hospitalPatient}'s pre-round editor open with its own autosaved line A

When The computer opens the same chart, adds line B and taps Save Note. The phone, editor still open, adds line C and waits 3 s. Run in both modes

Then The phone's open editor shows B without a refresh, and at the end the stored note holds A, B and C. Neither device's words are lost

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: cp1 (phone editor, no reload) mustContain 'QA-SYNC-PR-B' (Q4: whether an open editor must update); cp2 (computer, chart open, no reload or tap; Save Note closed its editor, so this reads the 60-character row) mustContain 'QA-SYNC-PR-B' and 'QA-SYNC-PR-C'; …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S15 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-25.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
